title: Coordinate permutation of a decision tree
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, let $n$ be a natural number, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree whose queries use those coordinates and whose branches are indexed by elements of $\Omega$. The coordinate-permuted tree is the finite decision tree obtained by applying the coordinate permutation to $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree over coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, with branch labels in $\Omega$ and leaf labels in $\alpha$
caveat: The snippet delegates the actual relabeling construction to an auxiliary definition that is not included, so its precise action on coordinate labels cannot be confirmed.
